description: This file defines the Java entity class 'DrugIngredient' for mapping to the 'drug_ingredient' table in a Hibernate ORM context within the OpenMRS project. It models the relationship between drugs and their ingredients, including properties like strength and units.

classes.name: DrugIngredient
classes.description: Entity class representing the relationship between a drug and its ingredients, including additional properties such as strength and units. It is mapped to the 'drug_ingredient' database table and uses Hibernate Envers for auditing.

methods.name: getIngredient
methods.description: Returns the ingredient represented as a Concept.

methods.name: setIngredient
methods.description: Sets the ingredient as a Concept.

methods.name: getStrength
methods.description: Returns the strength of the ingredient.

methods.name: setStrength
methods.description: Sets the strength of the ingredient.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units as a Concept.

methods.name: setUnits
methods.description: Sets the units as a Concept.
